title: Complete initiation plan: settled phase contract, later implementation and optional exchange breadth

reviews.classification: complete chronological implementation-plan owner; stale opening reconciled to its later source/native deliveries
reviews.disposition:
All698 pre-fold lines were read, including S1–S5/LI1–LI3/IG1–IG4, operation and hazard tablesH1–H7/H1a, D1–D5, LIP1–LIP5/LP1–LP5, local feature-auditAR1–AR11, M1–M6/MX1–MX7/HG1–HG8/LW1–LW8 and the Oct18–20 implementation/remainder updates. This is a chronological owner, not an unimplemented current assignment. Its opening runtime-not-implemented and IG1 runtime-authority-absent statements are superseded by the explicit Oct19 authorization and engine/native deliveries. The Oct20 update already prevents redispatching native binding/workroom/state from the old backlog. Later pathway, examination, acting guidance and ordinary-entry receipts further qualify its selected prototype boundary, without this review claiming current code was executed.

The useful phase contract remains precise: allocation is not source acquisition; committed ingestion/basic attention is not method mastery; abandoned formal teaching does not unconsume the dose; performed work and completion learning have different settlement points. D1's atomic success route is an authored granularity choice, not canon novice immunity, a universal guarantee or a requirement to expose acute interruption. D2's bounded enter/examine/end avoids a perpetual active mode for this slice; it does not prohibit genuine sustained powers later. D3's original six-unit capacity was explicitly changed to three in the engine slice; its values, one-minute examination, five-minute practice and120-minute completion recovery are authored tuning, not measured source physiology. Completion-only sleep does not claim partial rest has no value, and no UI action, reload or cancelled lesson supplies a free refill. The later native sleep sequence differs from initially proposed invariants and retains its recorded job/wake/reload limitations.

H1–H7 distinguish instruction, observed protagonist success, viewpoint inference and different-pathway severe cases. No fixed failure/death odds, generic panic-to-monster resolver, guaranteed supervisor rescue, permanent-madness-at-low-reserve rule or universal cure follows. Known warnings and later dangerous sources need their own actual consumer and observer knowledge; the selected routine loop does not require a catastrophe simulator. A one-person profile's absent incompatible prior source is not a world-wide path ban. The source edition/member ranges are historical bounded qualification, not fresh reading of full surrounding chapters or authenticated publication. A signal is not full identity, recipe or safety; D5's limited material perception cannot silently become omniscience. Conversely this one method's limits do not constrain every stronger acquired means under AD8/AD38.

The root publisher/native custody and compatibility distinctions remain valuable: one actual dose/sample owner, no duplicate prehistory ingredients, existing jobs/claims/source/faculty/knowledge owners, active-body/world coherence and failed-write preservation. Version/schema12, file counts/import names and six leaves are proposed/dated choices, not current admission APIs. Oct18 permits an explicit old-save reset/drop choice without authorizing stripping unknown active data, personal-save use or failure to persist newly created state. Local feature-audit AR1–AR11 are codes in this document, not replacements for registered architecture AR1–AR16; use the qualified owner when citing them. AD51 qualifies broad infrastructure requirements: build the first useful shared seam while retaining real local differences. No need to revive a missing native adapter merely because this older plan calls it absent.

M/MX/HG preserve venue discovery, real participants/stock, claims/means, actual agreement/payment/delivery, observer-specific secrecy and durable obligations. Membership, competence, clearance, cash/receivables and institutional supplies differ; a masked room, host rank, invoice or remote conversation does not create escrow, cargo, safety, truthful testimony or a paid service. Hosting itself is user-directed design space here, while two contacts, exact trust tracks, host remedies and event mechanics remain proposed later scope. Paid appraisal is this example's route rather than a universal fee; an effective means may work without a mandatory counter or error. Information copying need not consume the former holder's knowledge. LW ordinary rest/privacy/availability/material/literacy/identity/institution/professional-support cases do not demand eight new simulations, automatic social heat or general payroll. Old one-slice-first priorities, shared writer IDs and build windows are historical; current PROJECT governs sequencing and AD42 makes human play judgment optional feedback, not the final required gate.

Historical2271/2272tests and scratch native proof retain exact states. The recorded Export text supplied to literal Import was not proof of the actual Export-button download;1366DOM geometry and1800x944 screenshot were not1920/1536current target proof. Oct20 correctly records those closure gaps for its snapshot. Later current-target journeys and ordinary entry must be consulted at their own input identities; neither a plan nor this fresh read renews them. Preserve acquisition/control/reuse and useful later markets/gatherings/life details without adding a new runtime wave, observer store, universal hazard rule or source reread. The pre-consolidation snapshot remains separately unread by this batch; its stale relative-link base is not an executable handoff.
reviews.evidence: All698 current lines read in four140-line chunks plus138, no truncation. Linked source, pre-consolidation snapshot, runtime, private proof and new-game state not opened by proxy.
reviews.reopen: Inspect the exact current selected native phase/stock/clock/knowledge consumer and its later receipt before renewing any historical absent/implemented claim.
